$comment: Claude Code MCP catalog. Template only. ${env:VAR} resolves from .env or machine env at provision time; ${financeDir}, ${dataDir}, ${powerBiMcp} are path tokens resolved by Claude-Provision.ps1. Keys starting with _ are metadata and are stripped before registration. NEVER put real tokens in this file. Each server declares a _bucket; only selected buckets install. Servers whose _requires env vars are missing, or whose _requiresCommand is not on PATH, are skipped with a reason.

github._note: Repos, PRs, issues, code search. Token from .env. Create at https://github.com/settings/tokens

context7._note: Library/SDK docs. Works keyless; a key raises rate limits. Prefer over fetch for API syntax.

filesystem._note: Scoped to the finance OneDrive folder only. Use native Read/Grep for repo code.

powerbi-modeling-mcp._note: Edit live Power BI Desktop models. Resolved by globbing the installed VS Code extension; skipped if absent.

excel._note: Read/write xlsx. Paging limit is cells per response; ~8 tokens/cell, so 5000 is already ~40k tokens per read. Raise only with a reason.

duckdb._note: SQL over CSV, Parquet, Excel exports and the local analytics DB. Path is repo-local and stable across sessions.

markitdown._note: Local file conversion (PDF, Office, images) to markdown.

longhand._note: Lossless Claude Code session history. pip install -U longhand && longhand setup. Skipped if not on PATH.

fetch._note: Single known URL to markdown. Not for library docs (context7) or search.

parallel-search._note: LLM-optimized web search and fetch. Set PARALLEL_API_KEY for higher rate limits.

firecrawl._note: Scraping and crawling. Skipped unless FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is set.

magic._note: Magic UI components - animated React/Tailwind blocks. No key required.

fal-ai._note: Image/video/audio generation via fal.ai. Skipped unless FAL_KEY is set.

supabase._note: OAuth on first use. Skipped unless SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF is set.

higgsfield._note: Official Higgsfield connector - image and video generation (Sora, Veo, Kling, GPT Image, Seedance, Nano Banana Pro). OAuth against your Higgsfield account on first use; no API key in config. Credit-billed per generation, so it costs real money. Use the unofficial geopopos/higgsfield_ai_mcp packages only if you specifically need the local-server variant - they want HF_API_KEY + HF_SECRET and a Poetry checkout.

_buckets.core: Always installed - GitHub, library docs, finance-scoped filesystem.
_buckets.powerbi: Power BI semantic-model editing plus the Fabric skill pack.
_buckets.data: Analyst stack - Excel, DuckDB, markitdown, optional longhand.
_buckets.web: Browsing and search - Playwright, parallel-search, fetch, optional Firecrawl.
_buckets.webdev: SaaS and generation - Magic UI, fal.ai, Supabase, Vercel. Key-gated ones self-skip.

_retired.excel-mcp: Removed. Conflicted with the npx excel server (opposite access model - closed vs open workbook). The npx @negokaz server is the one in proven use.
_retired.excellm: Removed. Required a repo venv build step; replaced by npx @negokaz/excel-mcp-server.
